name: Estadisticas
description: Plugin de estadisticas de musica para Jellyfin. Registra reproducciones de audio en una base de datos SQLite propia (sin tocar la BD de Jellyfin) y genera informes Top 50 y Bottom 50 por cancion, artista, album y genero en multiples ventanas temporales. Permite crear listas de reproduccion y programar su publicacion.
overview: Estadisticas de musica independientes: Top 50 y Bottom 50 por cancion/artista/album/genero en ventanas de 2 semanas, 1, 3, 6 y 12 meses, y ano anterior. Base de datos SQLite propia. Purga automatica a los 14 meses con archivo historico anual.

versions.changelog:
- NEW: Pestaña 'Más votados' que consume un API externo de votos (JSON con campos itemId/score/title/artist). Resuelve cada itemId contra Jellyfin y arma la playlist 'Radio más votados' (top 50).
- Si faltan canciones para llegar a 50, se rellena con las más escuchadas de la última semana desde la base de datos propia.
- La playlist se reemplaza in-place (mismo ID) en cada generación.
- Programación semanal: día y hora configurables.
- La tabla muestra # / Canción / Artista / Álbum / Votos y NO consulta el API en tiempo real — sólo el resultado de la última generación.
- URL del API editable por el usuario (cualquier dominio, mientras la estructura JSON sea la misma).

- FIXED: DLL con versión correcta. En v0.0.0.17 el DLL tenía versión 0.0.0.16 causando ObjectDisposedException.
- IMPORTANTE: Borrar carpeta del plugin viejo antes de instalar.

- NEW: Script resolve_item_ids.py para llenar album_item_id y artist_item_id.
- FIXED: Portadas con selector de ventana temporal propio.
- FIXED: Álbum/artista del período con formato detallado en líneas separadas.
- FIXED: Collage 25 álbumes, 320px, tooltip con artista.
- FIXED: Heatmap excluye semana actual, max/min correctos.
- FIXED: Géneros Musicales barras más anchas.
- FIXED: Artistas con eje Y dual (plays/songs izq, tiempo der HH:MM:SS).
- FIXED: Formato fecha dd-MM-yyyy.

- NEW: Logros movido a Gráficos > Retos. Gamificación renombrada a Retos.
- FIXED: Timeline sin interpolación.
- FIXED: Heatmap: colores invertidos, cuadros grandes, 7 días completos, max/min display.
- FIXED: ByHour: colores grupos 6h, tooltip '13:00 hrs'.
- FIXED: ByDay: tooltip nombre completo.
- NEW: Treemap→barras horizontal 'Géneros Musicales' + 'Demás Géneros'.
- NEW: Gráfica Décadas. Lado a lado con Géneros.
- NEW: Bubble→grouped bar 'Artistas - Descubrimientos' (10 artistas, 3 métricas).
- NEW: Portadas con API Jellyfin images, 320px, 25 álbumes, tooltips.
- NEW: album_item_id + artist_item_id en tracks (cache de Jellyfin ItemIds).
- NEW: Endpoints /Charts/Decades, /Charts/TopAlbums, /Charts/TopArtists.

- CRITICAL FIX: AmbiguousMatchException en /Historical/Years. Atributo [HttpGet] huérfano eliminado.
- CRITICAL FIX: 'Value must be set' en RefreshYearlyAggregate. Parámetros null ahora usan DBNull.Value.

- FIXED: Heatmap respeta ventana temporal + escala dinamica de colores.
- FIXED: Graficos de hora/dia cambiados a barras (mas legibles).
- FIXED: Tamano de fuente +2 en todos los textos de graficos.
- FIXED: Boton Actualizar graficos en su propia fila.
- NEW: Sub-pestaña Portadas: album/artista del mes, collage, descubrimientos.
- NEW: Sub-pestaña Recap: tarjetas, comparativa trimestral, evolucion de generos.
- NEW: 4 endpoints /Charts/Recap, /Charts/QuarterCompare, /Charts/GenreEvolution, /Charts/Discoveries.

- NEW: Pestaña 'Gráficos' con 4 sub-pestañas (Estadísticas, Portadas, Recap, Gamificación).
- NEW: 6 gráficos en Estadísticas usando Chart.js: línea de tiempo, heatmap, radial por hora, radial por día, treemap de géneros, bubble chart de artistas.
- NEW: Racha de días consecutivos en Gamificación.
- NEW: 7 endpoints /Charts/* + ChartService.
- Sub-pestañas Portadas y Recap en v0.0.0.14.

- FIXED: Álbumes con el mismo nombre de distintos artistas ya no se mezclan. GROUP BY ahora usa COALESCE(album_artist, track_artists).
- NEW: Columnas ordenables en Tiempo Total Escuchado + columna #.
- NEW: Columna # en todas las tablas del histórico.
- NEW: Columna Género en Top 25 canciones y álbumes del histórico.
- NEW: Top 25 artistas y géneros del histórico lado a lado.
- NEW: Comparativa de años con Top 5 de cada categoría.
- CHANGED: Default de Top/Bottom cambiado a Canciones - Últimas 2 semanas - Año todos.

- NEW: Caché de consultas (QueryCache) con TTL de 1 hora. Resuelve los timeouts en Raspberry Pi.
- FIXED: Artistas ahora aparecen en canciones y álbumes (fallback a track_artists).
- FIXED: Álbumes con el mismo nombre de distintos artistas ya no se mezclan.
- NEW: Columnas Artista y Álbum separadas.
- FIXED: Total en tiempo total escuchado ahora es histórico real.
- FIXED: Formato de duración con zero-pad (131h 03m 05s).
- FIXED: Quitados códigos (2w) etc. de Resumen.
- FIXED: Regenerar histórico sin purga.
- FIXED: Alineación de Reproducciones a la derecha en histórico.
- FIXED: Scripts de importación/reparación con ItemValuesMap.

- FIXED: Script de importación corregido. Los tipos de ItemValues en Jellyfin 10.11 son: Artist=0, AlbumArtist=1, Genre=2 (antes estaban invertidos). Esto causaba que los artistas y géneros no se importaran.
- NEW: Script de reparación (scripts/repair_import.py) para usuarios que ya importaron. Re-lee la BD de Jellyfin y popula track_artists/track_genres para las canciones que faltan. También elimina plays duplicadas.
- NEW: Botón 'Regenerar histórico' en la pestaña Histórico. Fuerza la generación de agregados anuales sin esperar al 1º del mes. Útil después de importar datos.
- NEW: Endpoint POST /Historical/Regenerate.
- FIXED: Optimización de la consulta del Resumen. Antes hacía 6 queries separadas para contar plays por ventana; ahora hace 1 sola query con CASE WHEN (6x más rápida en BDs grandes).

- NEW: API pública con endpoints /Public/Stats (JSON) y /Public/Rss (RSS 2.0) para publicar estadísticas en webs externas. Documentación completa en docs/API.md.
- NEW: Pestaña 'Histórico' con visualización de agregados anuales: top 25 canciones/artistas/géneros/álbumes por año + comparativa lado a lado de todos los años.
- NEW: Pestaña 'Logros' con 30+ logros y niveles por mes/semestre/año. Insignias con iconos, barras de progreso, y categorías (Volumen, Diversidad, Tiempo, Niveles).
- NEW: Endpoints /Achievements, /Historical/Years, /Historical/Year/{year}, /Historical/Compare.
- NEW: AchievementService con cálculo de logros basado en el historial de escucha.
- NEW: HistoricalArchiveService con métodos de consulta (GetAvailableYears, GetYearSummary, GetYearComparison).

- NEW: Filtro por año de la canción en Top/Bottom manuales y en listas programadas. Permite consultas como 'lo más escuchado de 1982' o 'lo menos escuchado de 1995'.
- NEW: Tabla 'Tiempo total escuchado' en la pestaña Resumen. Muestra por género el tiempo total aproximado (suma de duraciones) en cada ventana temporal, con columna de total. Formato: 38h 20m 15s.
- NEW: Endpoints /Years (lista de años disponibles) y /ListeningTime (tiempo total por género x ventana).
- FIXED: Botón 'Consultar' ahora ocupa su propia fila (clase 'block') para alinearse correctamente con el botón 'Crear playlist' de abajo.
- UI: Selectors de Dimensión y Ventana temporal ligeramente más pequeños (min-width 10em) para dar espacio al nuevo selector de Año.
- Schema migration: columna 'year_filter' añadida a scheduled_playlists.

- NEW: Top 25/Bottom 25 ahora son Top 50/Bottom 50 en toda la UI y en las consultas (50 resultados).
- FIXED: Ventanas temporales corregidas (semanas de domingo a sábado): "Últimas 2 semanas" muestra las 2 últimas semanas completas y excluye la semana actual aunque esté en curso (ej.: si hoy es viernes, muestra desde el domingo hace 2 semanas hasta el sábado pasado). "Último mes" = mes calendario anterior completo (ej.: 01-Ago a 31-Ago; 28/29/30/31 según el mes). "Año anterior" = 01-Ene a 31-Dic del año pasado. "Últimos 3/6/12 meses" terminan el último día del mes anterior. Los límites se calculan con la hora del servidor (America/Guatemala, UTC-6).
- FIXED: Desempate de las menos escuchadas: menos reproducciones totales históricas y luego orden cronológico ascendente por el primer registro de la canción en la base de datos (las más antiguas primero, las más recientes de último).
- NEW: El encabezado de la segunda columna de la tabla muestra la dimensión consultada (Canciones/Artistas/Álbumes/Géneros) en lugar de "Nombre".
- NEW: UI de Top 50/Bottom 50: el botón Consultar quedó en la misma línea que Dimensión y Ventana temporal; el botón "Crear playlist con estos resultados" quedó junto al campo del nombre de la playlist.
- NEW: Listas programadas: nuevo selector de orden — Descendente (de la más escuchada a la menos escuchada) o Ascendente (de la menos escuchada a la más escuchada). Los empates se resuelven igual que en las menos escuchadas (menos reproducciones históricas, luego cronológico).
- NEW: Listas programadas: al elegir la dimensión Géneros aparece un selector de género musical (ej.: Top 50 de Rock de los últimos 3 meses). Se quitaron las dimensiones Artistas y Álbumes.
- CHANGED: Pestaña Debug renombrada a "Resumen" (sección "Información general"): una sola línea "Hora del servidor" (America/Guatemala), se quitó la inyección de datos de prueba y los textos de ayuda ("Cómo probar el plugin", etc.).
- CHANGED: "Borrar todos los datos" se movió al final de la página y pide confirmación con el diálogo nativo de Jellyfin.

- NEW: UI reescrita con componentes nativos de Jellyfin (emby-select, emby-input, emby-button, paperList, fieldDescription). Eliminado todo el CSS custom; ahora se usa la hoja de estilos propia de Jellyfin.
- NEW: Selector de hora con <select> y opciones cada 15 minutos (00:00, 00:15, ... 23:45), formateado segun locale del navegador (12h/24h). Patron tomado del plugin jellyfin-smartlists-plugin.
- NEW: La tarea 'Publicar listas programadas' ahora se ejecuta cada 1 minuto (antes 15). Las playlists sólo se publican en el momento exacto en que llega su programación (ej: lunes 08:00), no cada tick. Granularidad de ~60 segundos.
- OPTIMIZATION: No se captura position_ms (tiempo real escuchado) para minimizar I/O en Raspberry Pi con almacenamiento USB. El tiempo total escuchado se aproximará en el futuro sumando la duración total de cada canción (ya capturada en tracks.duration_ms).

- NEW: Captura del año de la canción (campo ProductionYear de Jellyfin) en la tabla tracks. Reservado para uso futuro (filtrar por año, ej: 'lo más escuchado de 1982').
- FIXED: Ortografía corregida al español de Guatemala: Álbumes, Géneros, Últimas/Últimos, Reproducción, Día, Miércoles, Sábado, Más, Aún, Todavía, Cómo, sólo, etc.
- NEW: Formato de fechas en dd-MMM-aaaa (ej: 05-Sep-2026) en toda la UI.
- NEW: Formato de horas en HH:MM (24h) en la pestaña de listas programadas.
- Se mantienen en inglés las palabras técnicas: Top 25, Bottom 25, Debug, playlist, tracks, plays.

- FIXED: Error 404 al hacer consultas. La URL se construia manualmente con serverAddress + path, lo que fallaba en servidores con reverse proxy. Ahora se usa ApiClient.getUrl() (el mismo patron que el plugin de podcasts).
- FIXED: Texto 'Ano' cambiado a 'Año' en todas las etiquetas de ventanas temporales y selects.
- NEW: Logo del plugin actualizado.

- FIXED: La UI se quedaba colgada con 'Consultando...' para siempre cuando el servidor devolvia un error no-JSON. Ahora el frontend maneja timeouts (30s), errores HTTP, y respuestas no-JSON con mensajes claros.
- NEW: Pestana 'Debug' con 3 botones: actualizar estado, inyectar datos de prueba (50 canciones sinteticas + ~1500 reproducciones distribuidas en las 6 ventanas temporales), y borrar todos los datos.
- NEW: Endpoints /Debug/Status, /Debug/SeedTestData, /Debug/ClearAll para testing sin esperar 2 semanas.
- NEW: Mensaje 'Sin resultados' mas util cuando una consulta devuelve 0 filas, explicando posibles causas y sugiriendo usar la pestana Debug.
- NEW: SqliteDb.IsInitialized flag; los endpoints verifican el estado de la BD antes de consultar y devuelven error claro si la BD no se inicializo.
- Mensaje de error mejorado en CreatePlaylist cuando no hay resultados.

- FIXED: SQLite syntax error 'near limit' que impedia iniciar Jellyfin. La columna 'limit' de la tabla scheduled_playlists era una palabra reservada de SQL; renombrada a 'playlist_limit'.
- FIXED: Si la inicializacion de la BD SQLite falla, el plugin se desactiva gracefulmente en lugar de tirar el servidor. Jellyfin ahora arranca aunque el plugin tenga errores.
- Compatible con Jellyfin 10.11.0+
- Initial release v0.0.0.1 (Alpha) — BROKEN: SQLite syntax error on startup. Use v0.0.0.2 or later.

name: Jellyfin Last.fm Plugin
description: Scrobble your music to Last.fm, update now playing status, and love/ban tracks directly from Jellyfin.
overview: Integrates Jellyfin with Last.fm for automatic scrobbling, now playing notifications, and track management (love/ban).

versions.changelog:
- Updated for Jellyfin 12.1 compatibility (net10.0, Jellyfin.Controller/Model 12.1.*)
- No API changes; recompiled against Jellyfin 12.1 packages

- Fix: Scrobble timestamp no longer jumps to the future when seeking forward
- PlaybackStopped now uses tracker start time directly instead of recalculating

- Fix: Scrobble replaced when changing tracks in Feishin/Amafy
- PlaybackStopped no longer sends duplicate scrobble if tracker already handled
- Consistent scrobble timestamps using recorded start time
- Fix: Scrobble lost on track change with Feishin
- Fix: Scrobbling now works - IHostedService for automatic startup
- Initial release for Jellyfin 10.10.7 (net8.0)

name: ListenBrainz
description: Scrobblea tu música a ListenBrainz desde Jellyfin. Actualiza el estado de ahora reproduciendo, envía scrobbles automáticamente y gestiona tus canciones favoritas.
overview: Integra Jellyfin con ListenBrainz para scrobbling automático, notificaciones de ahora reproduciendo y feedback de canciones (love/hate). Usa la API de ListenBrainz con autenticación simple mediante token de usuario.

versions.changelog: - v1.0.1.0: Fix listen_type playing_now. Fix nombre del paquete ListenBrainz. Checksum correcto.
- v1.0.0.0: Initial release for Jellyfin 10.10.7 (net8.0)

name: Podcasts
description: Manage podcast subscriptions with automatic RSS feed updates, episode downloads, auto-delete after listening, and daily auto-playlist generation.
overview: Subscribe to podcast RSS feeds, automatically download new episodes, manage auto-deletion of listened content, and generate a daily auto-playlist of unlistened episodes.

versions.changelog:
- NEW: Compatible with Jellyfin 12.1 (also works with 12.0)
- MIGRATED: Target framework from .NET 9.0 to .NET 10.0 (required by Jellyfin 12.x)
- MIGRATED: Jellyfin package references from 10.11.11 to 12.1.0
- FIXED: Replaced obsolete LinkedChild.Path with LinkedChild.ItemId only (Jellyfin 12 made playlists relational — LinkedChildren is now a DB table, Path is deprecated)
- targetAbi updated from 10.11.0.0 to 12.0.0.0

- CHANGED: ID3 TPE2 (Album Artist) tag now writes 'Podcasts' (plural) instead of 'Podcast' (singular) for consistency with the folder name and playlist name
- Applies to NEW downloads only — existing MP3s retain the previous 'Podcast' tag until manually re-tagged

- FIXED: 'Escanear biblioteca de podcasts' task now scans ONLY the podcast folder (the 'Podcasts' subfolder inside the music library) instead of the entire Jellyfin library
- NEW: Uses ILibraryManager.FindByPath + Folder.ValidateChildren for a targeted recursive scan of just the podcast folder
- NEW: Smart fallback — if the 'Podcasts' folder is not yet indexed by Jellyfin, scans only the parent music library to discover it (not the whole server)
- NEW: Last-resort fallback to full library scan only if neither the podcast folder nor the music library can be located
- Faster scan, does not touch movies/TV/other music libraries

- NEW: 4th scheduled task 'Escanear biblioteca de podcasts' - forces Jellyfin to scan the podcast folder for new files and add them to the database
- Recommended: run this task after 'Update feeds' so new episodes appear in the library immediately
- Uses ILibraryManager.ValidateMediaLibrary for a full library scan

- Fixed: ROOT CAUSE of duplicate playlists — added SemaphoreSlim lock to prevent concurrent playlist generation (scheduler + manual trigger race condition)
- Fixed: Playlist GUID now persisted to plain text file (playlist_id.txt) instead of PluginConfiguration XML (which was cached and not persisted immediately)

name: Radio Online
description: Automated online radio streaming plugin using Liquidsoap. Stream audio to Icecast servers with weekly playlist scheduling via Liquidsoap Telnet control.
overview: Automated online radio streaming via Liquidsoap to Icecast servers with weekly playlist scheduling. Assign Jellyfin playlists to specific day/time slots. Requires a Liquidsoap Docker container running alongside Jellyfin.

versions.changelog:
COMPATIBILITY: Plugin now targets Jellyfin 12.1 (was 10.11.8)
CHANGE: Target framework updated to .NET 10.0 (Jellyfin 12.x requirement)
CHANGE: Jellyfin NuGet packages updated to 12.1.0
CHANGE: targetAbi updated to 12.1.0.0
NOTE: This version is NOT compatible with Jellyfin 10.x. Use v0.0.0.51 for Jellyfin 10.11.x

NEW: NowPlaying JSON now includes itemId (Jellyfin's unique audio item ID) for direct database lookups
CHANGE: itemId is placed right after isPlaying in the JSON response

CRITICAL FIX: UTF-8 encoding in Telnet client — file paths with non-ASCII characters (é, ó, ñ, á, í, ú) are now sent correctly to Liquidsoap, fixing ~80% of silently skipped tracks
FIX: LiquidsoapClient.cs now uses UTF-8 encoding for all Telnet communications instead of ASCII (ASCII corrupted accented characters into '?' causing 'Nonexistent file or ill-formed URI' errors)
FIX: Telnet response reading also uses UTF-8 encoding for consistency
NOTE: Recommended radio.liq changes to further reduce latency and track skipping: disable enable_autocue_metadata(), reduce crossfade to 1.5s, add normalize_url=false to http.get

FIX: NowPlaying JSON year field now returned as quoted string (was unquoted integer causing JSON parse errors in external apps)
FIX: Artwork proxy now actually resizes images based on maxWidth parameter using Jellyfin IImageProcessor (was serving original full-size image regardless of maxWidth value)
FIX: Artwork proxy now uses async IImageProcessor.ProcessImage for proper image processing with SkiaSharp backend

CRITICAL FIX: Eliminated duplicate track reports — Jellyfin was reporting the same song 2-3 times (A,A,A,D,E,E,E pattern) while Icecast played correctly
CRITICAL FIX: NowPlaying JSON and Android app now show the correct current track instead of stale data from duplicate on_track callbacks
FIX: TrackChangeController made fully async — removed .GetAwaiter().GetResult() that caused thread pool starvation and request deadlocks
FIX: Duplicate suppression — same track reported within 15 seconds is suppressed (handles Liquidsoap firing on_track multiple times per play)
FIX: Removed backward drift correction — it caused duplicate track sends to Liquidsoap queue, making playlists longer than expected
FIX: Schedule change now takes immediate priority — RefillQueueAsync aborts if schedule changed, preventing old playlist from continuing past its time slot
IMPROVE: GetCurrentlyPlayingIndexAsync replaces VerifyPositionAsync — only detects stuck tracks, no longer modifies _nextTrackToSend counter

CRITICAL FIX: Liquidsoap stuck detection — when Liquidsoap stops advancing (codec error, corrupt file), the plugin no longer spams queue.append every 5 seconds in an infinite drift correction loop
FIX: VerifyPositionAsync now returns current track index to RefillQueueAsync for stuck detection
FIX: RefillQueueAsync pauses queue refill when Liquidsoap is stuck (same track across consecutive checks)
FIX: Automatically resumes normal refill when Liquidsoap advances past the stuck track
FIX: ResetState clears stuck state (_isStuck, _lastKnownCurrentIdx)

FIX: Tracks silently dropped by Liquidsoap (codec issues, corrupt files) no longer cause premature playlist end — plugin now detects position drift every 5 seconds
FIX: Position verification compares Liquidsoap reality (current_track + queue.length) vs plugin counter to detect skipped tracks
FIX: Playlist now loops automatically when all tracks exhausted but schedule is still active — prevents dead air
IMPROVE: VerifyPositionAsync runs as part of RefillQueueAsync cycle — minimal overhead (one extra Telnet query)
IMPROVE: Detailed warning log when tracks are skipped with exact count of dropped tracks

FIX: NowPlaying endpoint now returns isPlaying=false when radio stops — was stuck showing last track forever
FIX: ResetState() now clears CurrentTrack so the endpoint correctly reflects when transmission has ended

NEW: Public artwork proxy endpoint at /RadioOnline/NowPlaying/Artwork — serves album art without authentication
NEW: No Content-Disposition header — displays inline in browser instead of downloading
NEW: Cache-Control: public, max-age=300 — browsers cache artwork for 5 minutes reducing server load
FIX: artworkUrl in NowPlaying JSON now points to the proxy endpoint instead of Jellyfin's internal image endpoint
IMPROVE: Content-Type detected from file extension (jpeg, png, gif, webp)
IMPROVE: Returns 404 gracefully if no track is playing or album has no image

FIX: NowPlaying artwork URL now uses album ID instead of song ID — songs don't have Primary images, the artwork lives on the parent album (folder.jpg)
FIX: Eliminates "does not have an image of type Primary" error
IMPROVE: NowPlayingInfo now stores AlbumId (falls back to ItemId if no album parent found)

NEW: NowPlaying public endpoint at /RadioOnline/NowPlaying — returns current track metadata and album artwork URL as JSON for external apps and websites
NEW: Optional maxWidth parameter (default 720) to control artwork resolution (e.g. ?maxWidth=100 for thumbnails)
NEW: NowPlayingInfo class stores current track data (artist, title, album, year, duration, itemId)
IMPROVE: RadioStateService now stores NowPlayingInfo with thread-safe locking
IMPROVE: TrackChange stores metadata even when playback reporting is disabled
IMPROVE: Base URL built dynamically from incoming request (works behind Cloudflare tunnel, reverse proxy, any domain)
FIX: AssemblyVersion now correctly set in both Directory.Build.props and .csproj (was 0.0.0.15 due to stale duplicate project)

NEW: NowPlaying public endpoint at /RadioOnline/NowPlaying — returns current track metadata and album artwork URL as JSON for external apps and websites
NEW: Optional maxWidth parameter (default 720) to control artwork resolution (e.g. ?maxWidth=100 for thumbnails)
NEW: NowPlayingInfo class stores current track data (artist, title, album, year, duration, itemId)
IMPROVE: RadioStateService now stores NowPlayingInfo with thread-safe locking
IMPROVE: TrackChange stores metadata even when playback reporting is disabled
IMPROVE: Base URL built dynamically from incoming request (works behind Cloudflare tunnel, reverse proxy, any domain)
NOTE: No domain or IP is hardcoded — the endpoint auto-detects the correct URL from the HTTP request

CRITICAL FIX: ResetState() was called AFTER loading playlist tracks, wiping _playlistTracks to empty array — the for loop ran 0 times and no tracks were ever sent to Liquidsoap
FIX: Replaced ResetState() with _nextTrackToSend=0 to only reset the send index without destroying the loaded playlist
ROOT CAUSE: In v0.0.0.37, _playlistTracks was set at line 411, then ResetState() at line 431 cleared it — queue.append was never called

FIX: Plugin stuck in Inactivo state after failed queue attempts — _currentScheduleKey was set before verifying tracks sent, causing the plugin to never retry loading the playlist
FIX: _currentScheduleKey now only set on successful queue, cleared on failure so next cycle retries automatically
IMPROVE: Error message now includes 'will retry on next cycle' for clarity

ARCHITECTURE: Push metadata — Liquidsoap now TELLS the plugin what's playing via HTTP POST, eliminating all sync issues
NEW: TrackChangeController — HTTP endpoint at /RadioOnline/TrackChange receives track notifications from Liquidsoap
REMOVE: All sync code eliminated — _currentTrackIndex, VerifyTrackSyncAsync, TryResumeCurrentPlaylistAsync, OnReconnected, queue.remaining
SIMPLIFY: RadioStreamingHostedService now only manages buffer (keep queue.length >= 3) — no timing, no guessing
SIMPLIFY: LiquidsoapClient — removed OnReconnected event, HadPreviousConnection, GetQueueRemainingAsync
IMPROVE: Buffer refill based on queue.length instead of estimated timing — 100% reliable
IMPROVE: Resume on restart still works via queue.current_track + queue.length query
IMPORTANT: You MUST add on_track HTTP callback to radio.liq — see release notes
IMPORTANT: Remove queue.remaining command from radio.liq (no longer needed)

FIX: Plugin restart no longer resets playback to track 0 - on fresh start, queries what Liquidsoap is actually playing and resumes from that position (no audio interruption)
FIX: _currentTrackIndex desync eliminated on restart - Liquidsoap keeps playing uninterrupted while the plugin repositions its tracking to match
NEW: TryResumeCurrentPlaylistAsync - queries queue.current_track on startup, matches against playlist, and resumes tracking from the correct position
NEW: queue.remaining Telnet command for accurate track timing on resume (calculates _currentTrackStartedAt from remaining time)
NEW: GetQueueRemainingAsync in LiquidsoapClient
IMPROVE: ResetTrackingState moved after resume check - state is only reset if resume fails
IMPROVE: queue.length used on resume to estimate _lastQueuedTrackIndex, avoiding duplicate track queuing
NOTE: Resume only works for non-shuffle playlists (shuffle order changes each restart)
NOTE: You MUST add queue.remaining command to radio.liq - see release notes

FIX: Track desync after TCP reconnection - plugin now performs full bidirectional resync when Liquidsoap reconnects, correcting _currentTrackIndex to match actual playback
FIX: Backward drift detection - plugin now detects and warns when Jellyfin shows a song ahead of what Liquidsoap is actually playing (index converges naturally)
FIX: Reconnect resync bypasses 60-second throttle - runs immediately on reconnect event instead of waiting for next periodic check
NEW: OnReconnected event in LiquidsoapClient fires when a new TCP connection replaces a dropped one (not on first connect)
NEW: HadPreviousConnection property exposes whether a prior connection existed for meaningful reconnect detection
IMPROVE: VerifyTrackSyncAsync now uses exact match (Ordinal) instead of case-insensitive match for track path comparison

FIX: Duplicate tracks and out-of-order playback - removed queue depth resync that incorrectly reset _lastQueuedTrackIndex backward during crossfade transitions
FIX: queue.length now uses non-deprecated 'string()' function in radio.liq
IMPROVE: Queue depth monitoring is now diagnostic-only (warning log) without modifying playback state
NOTE: Update radio.liq with the corrected queue.length command from release assets

FIX: Playback interruptions eliminated - proactive TCP reconnection every 2 minutes prevents stale half-open connections that caused silent command failures
FIX: Queue depth verification - plugin now queries Liquidsoap's actual queue length before trusting local index, automatically resyncing when mismatch detected
FIX: Read timeout reduced from 10s to 3s - stale commands no longer block the semaphore for extended periods
IMPROVE: Buffer increased from 1 to 2 tracks ahead (3 initial tracks instead of 2) - tolerates multiple consecutive send failures before audio gap
NEW: queue.length Telnet command for real-time queue monitoring (requires radio.liq update)
NOTE: You MUST update your radio.liq to add the queue.length command - see release assets

NEW: Multi-day schedule support - each program can now repeat on multiple days via checkboxes (L M X J V S D)
NEW: Pause toggle per program - temporarily disable any schedule entry without deleting it
NEW: Unique entry IDs for reliable schedule change detection across day boundaries
IMPROVE: Schedule display shows compact day badges (active days highlighted in blue)
IMPROVE: Backward compatible - old single-day entries still work without migration
FIX: Overlap priority rule preserved - latest start time always wins

FIX: Track index only advances when the next track is confirmed queued in Liquidsoap - prevents gaps and offair interruptions
FIX: Failed track sends are retried on the next cycle instead of being skipped
FIX: Double playback reporting eliminated - each track is now reported exactly once using _lastReportedTrackIndex
FIX: Buffer maintenance improved - AdvanceTrackAsync wrapped in try/catch to prevent cycle crashes on telnet errors
FIX: Connection timeout resilience - if advance fails, the system recovers gracefully on the next 1-second cycle

FIX: Track advancement now works regardless of playback reporting setting - tracks are always sent one-by-one with buffer
FIX: Playback reporting is optional and does not affect track delivery
FIX: One-by-one mode sends all playlist tracks correctly (initial 2 + buffer as each track ends)

NEW: Playback reporting to Jellyfin statistics - tracks are sent one-by-one with buffer for accurate PlayCount and LastPlayedDate updates, enabling smart playlists (most played, least played, recently played)
NEW: Configurable option 'Report playback to Jellyfin statistics' in plugin settings
NEW: Track duration detection from Jellyfin metadata for precise advance timing
FIX: No longer requires queue.current_track telnet command (works with all Liquidsoap versions)
FIX: Playback reporting filters out tracks without duration metadata
IMPROVE: Tracks sent in small batches (2 initial + 1 buffer) instead of all at once - less telnet load, faster playlist transitions

NEW: Playback reporting to Jellyfin statistics - each track played on the radio now increments PlayCount and updates LastPlayedDate, enabling smart playlists (most played, least played, recently played, etc.)
NEW: Configurable option 'Report playback to Jellyfin statistics' in plugin settings
NEW: Liquidsoap queue.current_track telnet command for track monitoring
FIX: DLL now correctly reports AssemblyVersion 0.0.0.26 (was loading 0.0.0.24 due to stale Directory.Build.props)
FIX: Playback reporting filters out off-air audio and external radio streams
IMPROVE: Path-to-item mapping preserved through shuffle for accurate reporting

NEW: Playback reporting to Jellyfin statistics
NEW: Configurable option in plugin settings
NEW: Liquidsoap queue.current_track telnet command
FIX: DLL AssemblyVersion fix

FIX: Schedule now stops at exact programmed time - inverted clear+skip order (clear queue FIRST, then skip current track) so skip falls through to off-air instead of starting next queued track
FIX: Second playlist now properly takes priority when schedules overlap - clears queue and immediately loads next schedule
FIX: Times no longer drift/accumulate between schedules
FIX: Exception handler now clears Liquidsoap queue to prevent orphaned tracks from playing after errors
IMPROVE: Near-end polling checks every 1 second (instead of 5) when less than 30 seconds remain in schedule slot for precise timing

FIX: Dark theme dropdown menus in scheduling section (option backgrounds match Jellyfin dark theme)
FIX: Minute selector now shows all 60 minutes (00-59) instead of 5-minute increments
FIX: Schedule now ends at exact programmed time - skips current track and triggers crossfade instead of waiting for song to finish
FIX: Playlist switching at exact time with crossfade transition (skip + clear + load)
IMPROVE: Remaining time check prevents songs from playing past schedule end

FIX: Telnet Broken pipe - SendCommandAsync now retries once after reconnecting on IOException
FIX: Schedule not followed - now tracks full schedule key (day+time+playlist) instead of just playlist ID
FIX: Queue clear now retries up to 3 times on failure to ensure schedule transitions work reliably
FIX: Status endpoint shows correct telnet state after reconnect

name: Jellyfin YouTube Plugin
description: Reproduce videos de YouTube como Series en Jellyfin sin descargarlos. Usa archivos .strm + proxy local + yt-dlp.
overview: Agrega canales de YouTube y reproduce sus videos directamente como Series en Jellyfin. Sin descarga al disco. No requiere API key de YouTube - usa yt-dlp para todos los metadatos. Base de datos SQLite aislada de la BD principal de Jellyfin. Polling configurable por canal y políticas de retención.
